function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against the account record using the last 4 digits of PAN or birth year. Must be called and must return verified:true before any debt/EMI/amount information is disclosed. On success, the response also includes product, overdue_amount, and dpd — this is the ONLY source of that information for the assistant; it is deliberately not present in the system prompt, so verification failing or not having happened yet means the data simply isn't in context to leak.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or 4-digit birth year provided by the caller.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer after verification and disclosure. The server independently validates and can reject this: it returns success:false with error:"AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING" if amount is above the outstanding balance, or error:"PTP_DATE_NOT_FUTURE" / "PTP_DATE_INVALID" if the date isn't a valid future date. On rejection, nothing is logged — ask the customer for a corrected value and call this tool again rather than treating it as recorded.

ptp_date.description: A concrete future date in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2026-08-14. Resolve relative phrases like "Friday" to an actual calendar date before calling this tool.

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay. Must not exceed the account's outstanding balance — the server enforces this and will reject the call otherwise.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers a payment link to the customer's registered mobile number via SMS or WhatsApp.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Hands the call/case off to a human agent for hardship, dispute, or any request beyond the bot's authority (e.g. a discount).

notes.description: Short free-text summary of why this is being escalated.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called exactly once per call, at the end, regardless of which path the conversation took.
